The '''Obas base''' was a facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Obas]] operated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At one point, it faced destruction after its environmental control systems failed.
